jobDescription:
Founding Engineer — Seed-Stage Startup (5 people)

We just raised a seed round and are looking for our fourth engineer. You will
own entire product surfaces. There is no one to hand things off to.

The reality of this job
- You will write the feature, deploy it, and answer the support ticket
- Priorities change weekly. We ship to production several times a day
- You will talk to customers directly, and their feedback will change your code
- Scope is yours to define. Nobody will write you a spec

Who does well here
- People who have built and shipped something of their own — a company, a
  product with real users, an open-source project people depend on
- Generalists: frontend, backend, infra, and enough ML to be dangerous
- Evidence of ownership over evidence of pedigree. Tell us about revenue,
  users, retention, or anything you moved that had a number attached to it
- Bias to action. We would rather see a rough thing shipped than a clean plan

If you have run something yourself, lead with that. That is the signal we
weight above everything else on the resume.
